name: Signature Pad
description: A Harbor agreement with ink that thins as the pen speeds up, plus undo, a stroke replay and an SVG export.

props.name: clause
props.description: The sentence block above the signature plates.

props.name: parties
props.default: Mira Chen for Harbor, Jordan Hale for Northwind
props.description: Everyone on the agreement. Each has a name, role, org, date and strokes. A stroke is normalized points with timestamps.

props.name: openId
props.description: Which plate accepts ink, undo, replay and export.

props.name: weight
props.description: Fine is a note in the margin. Mark is a signature. Both still thin as the pen speeds up.

props.name: showBaseline
props.description: The rule the ink sits on.

props.name: accent
props.description: Pen colour. Near-black reads as ink on the paper.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black shell with paper plates, or the white inverse. The paper stays warm either way.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the open party's strokes after a draw, undo or clear.
